answer_1.quote: This work is motivated by the need to enhance the learning efficiency of CSG models using CL.
answer_1.outputs: The paper addresses conditional sentence generation (CSG) tasks including instruction tuning, machine translation (textual, multimodal, speech-to-text), and code generation, where natural language outputs are generated based on input conditions.

answer_2.quote: For the MT tasks (TMT, MMT, and ST), we report both the widely used BLEU score ... as well as the recently introduced COMET score ... which shows higher correlation with human judgments.
